index.pages.items.title: Items
index.pages.items.description: Monumenta Item Browser to easily find items.
index.pages.builder.title: Builder
index.pages.builder.description: Monumenta Build Maker to share class builds and see their statistics.
items.enchant.meleeProtection: Multiplies melee damage taken by 0.96 ^ (2 * level).
items.enchant.projectileProtection: Multiplies projectile damage taken by 0.96 ^ (2 * level).
items.enchant.magicProtection: Multiplies magic damage taken by 0.96 ^ (2 * level).
items.enchant.blastProtection: Multiplies explosion damage taken by 0.96 ^ (2 * level).
items.enchant.fireProtection: Multiplies fire damage taken by 0.96 ^ (2 * level). Reduces fire duration by 10% per level.
items.enchant.featherFalling: Multiplies fall damage taken by 0.96 ^ (3 * level).
items.enchant.shielding: Gain effective Armor to grant up to 20% / 25% / 30% bonus EHP when taking damage from an enemy within 2.5 blocks. Taking damage that would stun a shield and activates Shielding reduces Shielding's effect to half for 5 seconds.
items.enchant.poise: Gain effective Armor to grant up to 20% / 25% / 30% bonus EHP when above 90% Max Health. Half of the bonus is granted when above 70% Max Health.
items.enchant.inure: Gain effective Armor to grant up to 20% / 25% / 30% bonus EHP when taking the same type of mob damage consecutively (Melee, Projectile, Blast, or Magic) within 60 seconds.
items.enchant.steadfast: Gain effective Armor to grant up to 20% / 25% / 30% bonus EHP. This bonus scales linearly with the amount of HP you are missing, up to 60%.
items.enchant.evasion: Gain effective Agility to grant up to 20% / 25% / 30% bonus EHP when taking damage from a source further than 4 blocks from the player.
items.enchant.reflexes: Gain effective Agility to grant up to 20% / 25% / 30% bonus EHP for 0.65s after damaging any mob. DoT/indirect damage abilities cannot trigger this bonus. The bonus is granted at half effectivity for an additional 0.35s.
items.enchant.ethereal: Gain effective Agility to grant up to 20% / 25% / 30% bonus EHP when taking damage within 1.5 seconds of any previous damage from mobs.
items.enchant.tempo: Gain effective Agility to grant up to 20% / 25% / 30% bonus EHP when taking damage after 4 seconds of taking no damage from mobs. Half of the bonus is granted after 2.5 seconds of taking no damage from mobs.
items.enchant.guard: Gain effective Armor to grant up to 20% / 25% / 30% bonus EHP after blocking with a shield. Duration lasts for 4s if blocked from offhand, and 6s from mainhand. The bonus is also granted for 2s when taking 35% or greater HP at once.
items.enchant.cloaked: Gain effective Agility to grant up to 20% / 25% / 30% bonus EHP when there's 2 or less enemies within 5 blocks. Half the bonus is granted if there are 3 or less enemies. The full bonus is also applied for 6 seconds after slaying an Elite or Boss enemy.
items.enchant.adaptability: Allows secondary enchants (ex: Shielding, Reflexes, etc.) to all work with the defense type (Armor or Agility) you have the most of.
items.enchant.secondWind: Damage from attacks applied to the lower half of your max health is multiplied by 0.9^(level). Attacks received while under this threshold get their damage reduced; attacks that bring you under this threshold have the portion of the damage that is applied past the threshold reduced.
items.enchant.spellPowerBase: Increases the damage of spells. Only works with Mage skills. Stacks with Magic Damage attribute.
items.enchant.knockback: Adds (level * 3) blocks to your knockback on melee strikes.
items.enchant.fireAspect: Adds (level * 4) seconds of burning to the target.
items.enchant.iceAspect: Adds (level * 10%) slowness for 5 seconds to the target. Deals 1 extra damage to Blazes.
items.enchant.thunderAspect: Adds (level * 10%) chance to stun the target for 50 ticks (10 for elites). Deals 1 extra damage to Guardians and Iron Golems.
items.enchant.decay: Applies a Decay effect that deals (level) Ailment DPS for 4 seconds.
items.enchant.smite: Adds (level * 2) extra damage to melee hits against Undead mobs.
items.enchant.hexEater: Adds (level * 0.5) extra damage per debuff on the target.
items.enchant.duelist: Adds (level * 2) damage against non-undead human-like enemies.
items.enchant.slayer: Adds (level * 2) extra damage to melee hits against non-Undead, non-human-like mobs: Spiders, Cave Spiders, Creepers, Endermen, Blazes, Ghasts, Slimes, Magma Cubes, Silverfish, Bees, Shulkers, Wolves, Ravagers, Hoglins, and passive animal mobs.
items.enchant.abyssal: While equipped, you deal an additional (level * 10)% damage if either you or the enemy you are damaging is in water.
items.enchant.regicide: While equipped, deal an additional (level * 10)% damage to Elite and Boss enemies.
items.enchant.inferno: Ignited enemies take (level) ailment damage every second for the duration they are on fire. Subsequent reapplications of Inferno refresh its duration.
items.enchant.chaotic: Your weapon deals anywhere between +Level and -Level damage, in integer increments, on basic melee, projectile and Alchemist Potion hits. This effect is halved for sweep attacks.
items.enchant.lifeDrain: Heals the player for sqrt(level) for critical hits and (0.5 * sqrt(level) / sqrt(attack speed) * Attack Cooldown) for non-crits.
items.enchant.sweepingEdge: Increases sweep damage by (1 + attack damage * (level / (level + 1))).
items.enchant.arcaneThrust: Your attacks damage all enemies 3 blocks in front of you, in a 0.6-block-wide line for (1 + melee damage dealt * level / (level + 1)).
items.enchant.bleeding: Applies (level) stacks of Bleed to enemies struck by the Bleeding weapon. Bleed stacks last 5s, applying (for normal enemies) 3% Weakness per stack. At 8 stacks, the mob Hemorrhages, losing all stacks and taking 25% max health as damage, capped at (region * 35) flat damage. Bosses instead receive 1% Weakness, stacking up to 20, and Hemorrhage for a flat (region * 100) damage. Hemorrhaged mobs are Weakened by 30% for 5s and cannot gain Bleed stacks during this time.
items.enchant.quake: Upon killing an enemy with a direct melee or projectile attack, all nearby enemies within 3.5 blocks take (level * 10)% of the damage dealt. The weapon's Aspect enchantments, Decay, and Bleed are also applied.
items.enchant.flame: Projectiles set enemies on fire for 5 seconds.
items.enchant.frost: Inflicts 20% Slowness for 4 seconds to the target. Blazes take +1 extra damage.
items.enchant.spark: 50% chance to stun targets for 0.5 seconds. Guardians and Golems take +1 extra damage.
items.enchant.pointBlank: Deals (level * 2) more damage to targets within 8 blocks of the player.
items.enchant.sniper: Projectiles deal an additional (level * 2) damage if the enemy is further than 12 blocks.
items.enchant.recoil: When firing a projectile weapon, get knocked back a short distance, increasing with level. Crouching while firing prevents the recoil, but places the weapon on cooldown for 0.5 seconds.
items.enchant.retrieval: Arrows have a (level * 10)% chance to not be consumed.
items.enchant.multishot: Crossbows enchanted with Multishot fire 3 projectiles at once in a spread pattern. Only one projectile is consumed and only one out of the 3 can be picked up off the ground.
items.enchant.quickCharge: Decreases the time it takes to load a crossbow by (level * 0.25) seconds.
items.enchant.piercing: Lets arrows pass through up to the number of entities equal to the enchantment level.
items.enchant.looting: Increases common loot drops by (Enchantment level) chances.
items.enchant.efficiency: Increases the speed at which you break blocks with the enchanted item. If on an Axe, it also increases the chance of stunning a shield by an additional 5% per level.
items.enchant.fortune: Increases the number of resources gained when breaking ores and certain other blocks that drop resources, based on level.
items.enchant.lure: Decreases the time spent waiting for a fish to appear by (level * 5) seconds.
items.enchant.silkTouch: Allows blocks to drop themselves instead of their normal drop.
items.enchant.multitool: Allows a tool to change shape when you right-click with it. Level I lets it to cycle between a shovel and an axe, or a compass and shears, depending on the item. Level II additionally lets it cycle to being a pickaxe.
items.enchant.sapper: Restore (Enchantment Level) health by breaking a spawner.
items.enchant.debarking: Strips the bark off the logs you chop down.
items.enchant.barking: Magically regrows the bark onto the logs you chop up.
items.enchant.eruption: Mining a spawner deals (level * 4) damage to mobs within 5 blocks and apply the effects of Fire, Ice, Thunder, and Wind Aspects as well as Decay to affected mobs. Thunder Aspect applied via Eruption always stuns mobs, for (level * 0.3) seconds. Additionally, apply effects of Sapper and Adrenaline to players within 8 blocks, if the pickaxe used to mine the spawner has the enchantment.
items.enchant.riptide: A Trident with Riptide can only be thrown when in water. When this happens, you are launched with your Trident a distance based on your Riptide level.
items.enchant.unbreaking:
Makes gear break (level + 1)x slower.
Works the same on tools, weapons, and armor.
items.enchant.unbreakable: No durability is taken when used.
items.enchant.mending: Items with Mending that are worn or held repair 2 durability per xp orb consumed, chosen at random among your items with Mending.
items.enchant.infinity: Bows and crossbows do not consume vanilla arrows, potions never go empty, and food never runs out.
items.enchant.darksight: Gives night vision when held or worn.
items.enchant.radiant: While held in your main hand, gain Glowing and Night Vision for 30s. You must be the soulbound owner of your item for this to work.
items.enchant.regen: Regain sqrt(level) health every 3 seconds, in small increments 4 times per second.
items.enchant.gills: While equipped or held, gain Water Breathing.
items.enchant.aquaAffinity: Removes penalty to mining speed while underwater.
items.enchant.depthStrider: Move (level * 33%) faster when in water. Caps at level 3.
items.enchant.respiration: Extends your breathing time underwater by (level * 15) seconds.
items.enchant.soulSpeed: When on soul sand or soul soil, your speed will increase by (level * 10.5%).
items.enchant.intuition: While equipped, grants 50% more experience, no matter the level.
items.enchant.sustenance: Increases amount of healing received by (level * 10)%.
items.enchant.adrenaline: Upon attacking an enemy, you gain (level * 10)% speed for 3 seconds. This has half efficiency on projectile damage. Upon breaking a spawner with a pickaxe, you gain (level * 5)% speed for 6 seconds.
items.enchant.weightless: May be held in the offhand without incurring a debuff from the Two Handed curse.
items.enchant.aptitude: Decreases the cooldown of all of your skills by 5% per level multiplicatively.
items.enchant.triage: Increases the amount of healing you do to others by (level * 5)%.
items.enchant.junglesNourishment: The food fully refills hunger bar. Gives 40% instant health and 5 seconds of 20% resistance. 25 second cooldown.
items.enchant.temporalBender: For the next 5 seconds, ability cooldowns recharge twice as fast. Restores 4 hunger and 4 saturation. 30 second cooldown.
items.enchant.liquidCourage: The next three incoming melee, projectile, or magic attacks within 15 seconds are reduced by 20%. Restores 8 hunger and 8 saturation. 30 second cooldown.
items.enchant.intoxicatingWarmth: For 12 seconds, restores 1 hunger and 1 saturation per second. 30 second cooldown.
items.enchant.resurrection: When you are about to die, this item provides 8 Absorption for 5 seconds, Regeneration 2 for 45 seconds, and Fire Resistance for 40 seconds, destroying itself in the process.
items.enchant.exorcism: Deals 15 damage and applies Slowness III to mobs summoned within the Valley of Forgotten Pharaohs.
items.enchant.instantDrink: Right-click to instantly be granted the item's effects.
items.enchant.ashesOfEternity: Saves player from death once a day, as if it were a Totem of Undying. The enchantment is then marked as "Used" until the beginning of a new day.
items.enchant.rageOfTheKeter: The food restores 4 hunger points and 4 saturation points and can be eaten at full hunger. Gives the player +20% melee/projectile/magic damage and +15% speed for 15 seconds. 25 second cooldown.
items.enchant.throwingKnife: Right-click to use the item and instantly fire an arrow.
items.enchant.corruption: Holding or equipping one item is fine, but too much corruption is bad for you...
items.enchant.cumbersome: Critical attacks deal normal damage instead. Abilities that require critical attacks can still be activated with a critical attack.
items.enchant.irreparability: Some items are too fragile to be repaired...
items.enchant.twoHanded: Some items simply cannot be used correctly if your hands are full... Reduces attack damage, attack speed, and spell power of the item, reduces player movement speed, and restricts the ability to throw/shoot projectiles if held while also having an offhand equipped. Two-handed swords count as holding two swords for sake of Rogue abilities.
items.enchant.ephemerality: All good things must come to an end. Will vanish when you log out, transfer shards, drop it, or try to move them to another inventory.
items.enchant.vanishing: When held in inventory, an item with Curse of Vanishing shatters upon death. Curse of Vanishing II will cause the item to be completely deleted upon death.
items.enchant.crippling: When under 50% health, your damage and movement speed is reduced by 10% per level.
items.enchant.shrapnel: When used to break a spawner or firing a projectile, take (level) damage. When attacking a mob with a melee hit, take (level)/2 damage. This damages armor and bypasses damage reductions.
items.enchant.anemia: Reduces amount of healing received by (level * 10)%.
items.enchant.starvation: Depletes your saturation and current hunger points by (Enchantment level) upon consuming the item cursed with Starvation. It fully depletes saturation, then moves on to removing hunger points.
items.enchant.ineptitude: Increases the cooldown of all of your skills by 5% per level multiplicatively.
items.enchant.theVeil: When equipped, drain (level) health once every 3 seconds. This damage cannot kill you, and only triggers if there is a hostile mob within 24 blocks, a boss within 80 blocks, or the player has dealt damage within the last 12 seconds.
items.enchant.gilded:
While equipped, you gain an aura of gold particles. While dropped, your item gains similar particles. Additional items increase your particles, capped at 10.
A reward for winning the voting raffle.
items.enchant.stylish: Players gain an aura of black particles.
items.enchant.festive: While equipped, gain an aura of festive particles that improve with every additional item.
items.enchant.divineAura: Players and attacked enemies gain an aura of divine particles.
items.enchant.stamina: After taking damage, any melee or projectile damage you deal within 5s is increased by (level * 2.5)%. Stacks up to 4 times, for (level * 10)% max damage, with duration refreshing each hit taken.
items.enchant.explosive: When dealing damage with critical projectiles, deals an additional (level * 10)% splash damage in a 2-block radius, which also applies any Fire/Ice/Thunder/Wind Aspect, Decay and/or Bleed enchants.
items.enchant.excavator: Mine extra blocks in a 3 x 3 shape. Sneaking disables the effect.
items.enchant.windAspect: Launch mobs on hit by (level) blocks and apply Slow Falling for 1 second.
items.enchant.earthAspect: On mob hit or spawner break, grants (level * 5)% damage reduction for 3 seconds.
items.enchant.trivium: When hitting 3 or more mobs with a magical ability, deal (level * 10)% more magic damage.
items.enchant.projectileFragility: Multiplies projectile damage taken by 1 - 0.96 ^ (-2 * level).
items.enchant.meleeFragility: Multiplies melee damage taken by 0.96 ^ (-2 * level).
items.enchant.magicFragility: Multiplies magic damage taken by 0.96 ^ (-2 * level).
items.enchant.blastFragility: Multiplies blast damage taken by 0.96 ^ (-2 * level).
items.enchant.fireFragility: Multiplies fire damage taken by 0.96 ^ (-2 * level).
items.enchant.retaliation: After blocking damage, gain a damage bonus for 4s based on the type of enemy blocked (35%/50%/65% for normal/elite/boss, halved when dealing magic/projectile damage). Certain blocked debuffs will infuse the first basic melee/projectile attack in this period with an effect corresponding to the blocked debuffs.
items.enchant.reverb: On kill by melee strike or basic projectile attack, deal (10 * level)% of your overkill damage plus (5 * level)% of your highest damage source within the killing attack to an enemy within 8 blocks. Enemies killed by this damage can also trigger Reverb.
items.enchant.broomstick: After being hurled using Riptide, apply slow falling until touching the ground.
items.enchant.instability: Randomizes the damage type of damage received when you get hit between Melee, Projectile, Magic, and Blast.
items.enchant.drilling: Breaking a spawner destroys one extra Spawner Shield per level.
items.enchant.firstStrike: The first melee hit against a mob deals (10% * level) more damage, and the first projectile or alchemist bag hit against a mob deals (7.5% * level) more damage. Melee damage from enchantments and abilites is affected if applied simultaneously with a triggering melee hit. Refreshes every 3 seconds.
items.enchant.technique: When damaging a mob within 3 blocks, deal 10 * level % more magic, projectile, and melee ability (not physical) damage.
items.enchant.impact: For the next 2s after you attack a mob, deal an additional (level * 10)% of your physical attack's damage to the mob when they hit a wall, or if they fall from more than 3 blocks. Hit enemies lose (level * 10)% Knockback Resistance.
items.enchant.material: A special item, used to craft another item - often Patron related ones. Items with this enchant also can be used as crafting materials in regular vanilla Minecraft recipes.
items.enchant.snowy: While you have an item with this enchantment in your inventory, you are able to be hit by other players with a Snowball Launcher. Be careful!
items.enchant.worldlyProtection: While held, grants 5% damage reduction per level in King's Valley areas, 7.5% damage reduction per level in Celsian Isles areas, and 10% damage reduction per level in Architect's Ring areas. However, damage dealt is reduced by 25% per level. Additionally, items with this enchantment are not affected by region restriction debuffs.
items.enchant.fractal: After hitting an enemy with magic damage, you will deal (10% * Level) increased magic damage to that enemy for 2 seconds. This increase can only happen once every 6 seconds.
builder.errors.corruption: YOU HAVE MORE THAN ONE CURSE OF CORRUPTION ITEM
builder.errors.twoHanded: YOU ARE USING A TWO HANDED MAINHAND WITH A NON WEIGHTLESS OFFHAND
items.enchant.absorbingBarrier: When over 75% max health, and having not taken damage in the last 4s, passively generate up to (level * 10)% maximum health as absorption over 3s.
items.enchant.ailmentFragility: Multiplies ailment damage taken by 0.96 ^ (-2 * level).
items.enchant.ailmentProtection: Multiplies ailment damage taken by 0.96 ^ (2 * level).
items.enchant.alchemicalUtensil: Marks the item as an Alchemist's Utensil.
items.enchant.backstab: Deal 15 * level % more melee damage to mobs when striking from behind.
items.enchant.breezing: Launch yourself when hitting a mob by (level * 1.5) blocks, applying Slow Falling for 1 second.
items.enchant.consumable: On use, the item is consumed, like how arrows are with bows and crossbows.
items.enchant.fallFragility: Multiplies fall damage taken by 0.96 ^ (-3 * level).
items.enchant.grappling: Your crossbow will act as a grappling hook, allowing you to pull yourself up to level blocks, with an emphasis on vertical distance. Shooting arrows consumes charges. Charges replenish every 5 seconds. Sneaking near a hook (including mid-air) will pick it up and replenish one of your charges early. After shooting a block, left-click to pull yourself towards the block. Sneaking will prevent yourself from being pulled. Also allows you to grapple yourself to mobs. Left-click while sneaking to pull mobs to you. Disables projectile-based abilities while held.
items.enchant.infection: Spreads debuffs to nearby mobs (1 per level) on melee/projectile kill, with (level) additional seconds of duration.
items.enchant.kineticLoading: On a successful critical melee attack, instantly reload a crossbow from your Quiver, reset the cooldown of a Trident, Snowball or Throwing Knife, or regain an Alchemist Potion.
items.enchant.multiLoad: Upon reloading your crossbow, consume up to level extra arrows. For each arrow consumed, instantly reload crossbow after firing.
items.enchant.oversized: Using an item with Oversized sets all projectile weapons in your hotbar on cooldown. Using an item without Oversized puts all projectile weapons with Oversized in your hotbar on cooldown.
items.enchant.pestilence: When dealing direct (not ability) melee or projectile damage, you have a (10% * level) chance to receive a random debuff out of Poison 1, Hunger 2, 15% Vulnerability, -15% Speed, or -30% Healing. The debuff lasts for 6 seconds.
items.enchant.rebound: Upon shield stun, enemies within 4 blocks of you are knocked away and take (level * 5) damage. Aspect enchantments, Decay, Bleed, Knockback, and Impact are also applied.
items.enchant.regeneration: When equipped, regain sqrt(level) / 12 health 4 times per second.
items.enchant.skyseeker: While equipped, deal an additional (level * 10)% damage to enemies who are above you.
items.enchant.spiritshot: Allows the weapon to be used in the Spirit Archery Minigame.
items.enchant.tactician: Deal (level * 12.5)% more damage to stunned mobs. Deal (level * 7.5)% more damage to mobs that are paralyzed, frozen, rooted, blinded, or staggered.
items.enchant.transposing: Swapping your hand items teleports you and another player holding a matching Totem of Transposing to swap positions, up to 80 blocks away. 5 second cooldown.
items.enchant.utilityItemForArmory: Marks the item as a utility item for the Armory.
items.enchant.warpstrike: Killing a mob teleports you to its location instantly.
items.enchant.webbing: Damaging elite mobs creates cobwebs... to slow them down, of course!
items.enchant.aquaaffinity: Allows you to mine blocks underwater as if you were on land.
items.enchant.firststrike: The first melee hit, projectile damage or thrown Alchemist Potion against a mob deals 10 * level % more damage. Melee damage from enchantments or abilities will also be affected if it is applied simultaneously with a melee hit. The bonus damage can be reapplied to the same target every 3 seconds.
items.enchant.locked: Prevents the item from being swapped by a lockbox.
items.enchant.orbital: When you hit or are hit by an airborne mob, knock them downward. Take 1.5% * level less damage from airborne mobs.
items.enchant.featherfalling: Multiplies fall damage taken by (0.96) ^ (3 * level).
items.enchant.junglesnourishment: When consumed, restore all hunger, gain 40% Instant Health, and gain 20% Resistance for 5s. Cooldown: 25s.
items.enchant.carapace: After being hit by a mob, gain (level * 1.25)% damage reduction for 5 seconds, refreshed on being hit.
items.enchant.armor:
One of Monumenta's primary defensive stats, along with Agility.
Multiplies received damage taken by 0.96^Armor.
If Armor and Agility are mixed, damage is multiplied by 0.96^(Armor + Agility - 0.5 * Armor * Agility / (Armor + Agility))
items.enchant.fireprotection: Multiplies fire damage taken by (0.96) ^ (2 * level). Reduces fire duration by 10% per level.
items.enchant.execution: After killing an enemy, you deal (level * 1.5)% extra damage for 4 seconds.
items.enchant.hexeater: Adds (level * 0.5) extra damage per debuff on the target to basic melee, projectile or Alchemist Potion hits.
items.enchant.instantdrink: Right clicking a potion with this enchant will instantly apply its effects to the player using it.
items.enchant.unrustworthy: Removes all rust from mined copper.
items.enchant.divineaura: While equipped, the player and mobs hit gain an aura of divine particles.
items.enchant.kineticloading: On a successful critical melee attack, instantly reload a crossbow from your Quiver, reset the cooldown of a Trident, Snowball or Throwing Knife, or regain an Alchemist Potion.
items.enchant.rustworthy: Curses mined copper to gather rust depending on the level.
items.enchant.refresh: Reduces the cooldown of infinite consumables by 2% per level.
items.enchant.fireaspect: Ignites the target for (level * 4) seconds when dealing melee or projectile damage.
items.enchant.decapitation: On a melee critical strike, deal (1.25 * level)% additional damage.
items.enchant.ailmentprotection: Multiplies ailment damage taken by (0.96) ^ (2 * level).
items.enchant.unyielding: Increases your Knockback Resistance by 8% per level.
items.enchant.meleeprotection: Multiplies melee damage taken by (0.96) ^ (2 * level).
items.enchant.thunderaspect: Has a (level * 10)% chance to stun a mob for 2 seconds (0.5 for Elites) when dealing melee damage, or for 0.5 seconds (0 for Elites) when dealing projectile damage. Deals 1 extra damage to Guardians and Iron Golems.
items.enchant.ardor: Mining a spawner outside of water grants you (level * 2)% speed for 4s. Mining a spawner underwater refreshes (level * 0.5) breath.
items.enchant.fervor: Deal 1.5% additional damage per level for 3s after gaining a buff that lasts at least 5s.
items.enchant.ailmentfragility: Multiplies ailment damage taken by (0.96) ^ (-2 * level).
items.enchant.sturdy: Reduces the duration shields are stunned for by 5% per level.
items.enchant.liquidcourage: When consumed, gain 8 hunger, 8 saturation, and 20% Resistance against 3 incoming Melee, Projectile or Magic attacks for 15s. Cooldown: 30s.
items.enchant.firefragility: Multiplies fire damage taken by (0.96) ^ (-2 * level).
items.enchant.blastfragility: Multiplies blast damage taken by (0.96) ^ (-2 * level).
items.enchant.statTrack: Designates that an item has had stat tracking added to it via a Patron. Stats are only tracked if used by the person who added it as long as they're still a patron. A variety of different stats can be tracked, such as Mobs Killed, Times Consumed, Boss Damage Dealt, and more! Consider becoming a patron if you aren't one already to gain access to this perk.
items.enchant.ashesofeternity: Applies the effect of Resurrection upon death while holding in mainhand. When a player triggers this effect, the enchant is marked as "Used" and becomes unusable to them until the next new day. The enchant is refreshed and mark is removed when clicking with the item in mainhand, if a new day has occurred since last use.
items.enchant.choler: Deal (level * 1)% additional damage to any mob that is on fire (vanilla or Inferno), slowed, or stunned.
items.enchant.celestial: Deal 1.5 * level % more damage to enemies at a higher elevation than you.
items.enchant.stasis: While Stasis is active, you are immovable, immune to all damage and effects, and cannot use any interactions or abilities.
items.enchant.temporalbender: When consumed, gain 4 hunger, 4 saturation, and +100% Ability Cooldown Recharge Rate for 5s. Cooldown: 30s.
items.enchant.vigor: Gain (level * X)% melee damage, where X is 1/1.25/1.5 in regions 1/2/3.
items.enchant.projectileprotection: Multiplies projectile damage taken by (0.96) ^ (2 * level).
items.enchant.meleefragility: Multiplies melee damage taken by (0.96) ^ (-2 * level).
items.enchant.galvanic: Gain a 1.25% chance per level to stun a mob for 2 seconds (0.5 seconds for elites) when dealing or taking non-ability melee or projectile damage.
items.enchant.throwingknife: Right-click to instantly fire an arrow, applying all enchantments and attributes. Damages the item by 1 point of durability if it has Infinity, or consumes it if it does not. Inherits Oversized, putting all projectile weapons on cooldown on use.
items.enchant.perspicacity: Gain (level * X)% magic damage, where X is 1/1.25/1.5 in regions 1/2/3.
items.enchant.quench: Increase duration of consumable's effects by 2.5% per level.
items.enchant.earthaspect: Upon dealing melee damage, grants (level * 5)% damage reduction for 3 seconds. The same effect with half of the damage reduction applies when dealing projectile damage. Also applies upon mining a spawner.
items.enchant.spellPower: Increases the damage of spells (+20% Spell Power increases the damage of all spells by 20%, for example), and only works with Mage skills. Spell Power stacks multiplicatively with the Magic Damage attribute.
items.enchant.reflection: 1 second after taking magic or blast damage, deal (level * 6)% of the damage to all mobs in a 4 block radius.
items.enchant.focus: Gain (level * X)% projectile damage, where X is 1/1.25/1.5 in regions 1/2/3.
items.enchant.mitosis: Mining a spawner debuffs all enemies in a 5 block radius with (level * 3.75)% Weaken for 3 seconds.
items.enchant.owned: Establishes ownership of an item for either a player or a guild. This infusion can only be removed by the specified owner of the item.
items.enchant.vengeful: Deal (level * 2)% additional damage to the last mob that damaged you.
items.enchant.depthstrider: Allows you to move faster by (level * 33)% when in water.
items.enchant.silktouch: Allows blocks to drop as themselves instead of their normal drop, when broken with an item with this enchantment.
items.enchant.rageoftheketer: When consumed, gain 4 hunger, 4 saturation, a +20% damage buff to melee, magic, and projectile damage, and +15% speed for 15s. Cooldown: 25s.
items.enchant.epoch: Class abilities cooldowns are reduced by (level * 1)%.
items.enchant.usurper: Heal (level * 2.5)% of your max health whenever you slay an elite or boss enemy.
items.enchant.empowered: When you gain XP, you have a 0.25% chance per XP point per level to repair all currently equipped items by 1% of their max durability. There is also a slight prioritization to more damaged items.
items.enchant.magicfragility: Multiplies magic damage taken by (0.96) ^ (-2 * level).
items.enchant.enlightening: Uses the power of a Tesseract of Light (u) to place torches under falling blocks.
items.enchant.projectilefragility: Multiplies projectile damage taken by (0.96) ^ (-2 * level).
items.enchant.soulspeed: When on soul sand or soul soil, your speed will increase by (level * 10.5)%.
items.enchant.hope: If this item would be inflicted with more than 1 shatter level from a death, it takes 1 level less.
items.enchant.understanding: All non-Delve Infusions you are currently benefitting from gain (Understanding level * .2) levels.
items.enchant.pointblank: Projectiles deal an additional (level * 2) damage if the enemy is within 8 blocks.
items.enchant.waxon: Applies wax to mined copper as your master taught you.
items.enchant.intoxicatingwarmth: When consumed, gain 1 hunger and 1 saturation per second for 12s. Cooldown: 30s.
items.enchant.windaspect: Launch mobs hit by (Level * 1.5) blocks and applies Slow Falling for 1 second.
items.enchant.TheVeil: When equipped, drain (level) health every 3 seconds. This damage cannot kill you, and only triggers if there is a hostile mob within 24 blocks, Boss mob within 80 blocks, or the player has dealt damage within the last 12 seconds.
items.enchant.phylactery: Dying with an item infused with Phylactery saves (10% * level) of your experience points in your grave. This stacks additively with itself across all items equipped. Experience will only be saved if you died with more than 100 experience points. Additionally, keep potion effects upon dying for (5% * level) of the duration.
items.enchant.agility:
One of Monumenta's primary defensive stats, along with Armor.
Multiplies received damage taken by 0.96^Agility.
If Armor and Agility are mixed, damage is multiplied by 0.96^(Armor + Agility - 0.5 * Armor * Agility / (Armor + Agility))
items.enchant.waxoff: Removes wax from mined copper as your master taught you.
items.enchant.magicprotection: Multiplies magic damage taken by (0.96) ^ (2 * level).
items.enchant.blastprotection: Multiplies blast damage taken by (0.96) ^ (2 * level).
items.enchant.sweepingedge: On non-critical fully charged melee swings, deals (20% * level) of the triggering attack's damage in an AoE around the targeted mob. Mobs must be within 3 blocks of the player's head or feet to be hit.
items.enchant.aura: Mobs in a 3 block radius from you are slowed by (level * 3)% for 0.5 seconds. This is refreshed as long as they are in range.
items.enchant.revelation: Items infused with Revelation increase the level of any Delve infusion on the item by one level.
items.enchant.ammunition: Allows bows or crossbows to preferentially draw the selected arrow from a Quiver. Right-click the weapon in inventory with the preferred arrow to select it. Right-click the weapon in inventory with an empty hand to wipe the preference.
items.enchant.natant: You move (level * 4)% faster when in water.
items.enchant.colossal: Items reinforced with Colossal don't take durability damage 50% of the time. Works with the Unbreaking enchant.
items.enchant.multiload: Upon reloading your crossbow, consume up to (level) extra arrows. For each arrow consumed, instantly reload crossbow after firing.
items.enchant.soothing: Regenerate 0.04 health per level each second.
items.enchant.expedite: Once per tick, damaging an enemy with an ability increases your movement speed by (level * 0.75)% for 5 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.
items.enchant.celerity: Gain 2.5% Speed per level after not taking or dealing damage for 5 seconds.
items.enchant.thornsDamage: Deal (level) damage to a mob when it damages you with melee or projectile damage.
items.enchant.fueled: Gain 0.3% Damage Reduction per level for every enemy that is on fire (vanilla or Inferno), slowed, or stunned within 8 blocks, capped at 4 mobs.
items.enchant.iceaspect: Applies (level * 10)% Slowness for 4 seconds when dealing melee or projectile damage. Deals 1 extra damage to Blazes.
